summary: Field-by-field copy of a 2D transform/viewport struct. The source pointer arrives through the float-typed parameter a2. Copies an embedded string via a null-safe dereference plus a buffer-reallocating string copy, copies two 3-float vectors via F_3VectorCopyToStruct and VectorCopy, then fills the destination fields from a series of paired-field getter helpers (offsets 0x30..0x58), a few direct float/byte copies, a three-field getter result, a block of direct DWORD copies (0x70..0x84), and finally writes the square of the source value at byte offset 136 into destination byte offset 140.

operations.description: Null-safe dereference of the string pointer field at source+4.
Copy the dereferenced string with buffer reallocation.
Copy a 3-float vector from source+12 into the destination this struct.
Copy a second 3-float vector from source+144 into the destination this struct.
Copy DWORDs at destination offsets 0x90, 0x94 and 0x98 from the same source offsets.
Getter helper reads two float fields from the source struct at offsets 0x30 and 0x34.
Store the getter result pair into destination offsets 0x30 and 0x34.
Getter helper reads two float fields from the source struct (DualFieldGetter).
Store the getter result pair into destination offsets 0x38 and 0x3C.
Getter helper reads two float fields from the source struct (ShortComputation_6080).
Store the getter result pair into destination offsets 0x40 and 0x44.
Direct copy of the single float at source+72 into destination offset 0x48.
Getter helper reads two float fields from the source struct (DualFieldGetter_60a0).
Store the getter result pair into destination offsets 0x4C and 0x50.
Getter helper reads two float viewport fields from the source struct (RectViewportDimensionGetter).
Store the getter result pair into destination offsets 0x54 and 0x58.
Direct copy of the single float at source+92 into destination offset 0x5C.
Direct copy of the single byte at source+96 into destination offset 0x60.
Getter helper reads three fields (two floats and one int) from the source struct (MultiFieldGetter).
Store the three-field getter result into destination offsets 0x64, 0x68 and 0x6C.
Copy DWORDs at destination offsets 0x70, 0x74, 0x78, 0x7C, 0x80 and 0x84 from the same source offsets.
Direct copy of the float at source+136 into destination offset 0x88.
Compute destination offset 0x8C as the square of the source value read at byte offset 136.
Return the destination this pointer as the function result.

clean_pseudocode: for (int o = 0x90; o <= 0x98; o += 4) *(int *)(dst + o) = *(int *)(src + o);
for (int o = 0x70; o <= 0x84; o += 4) *(int *)(dst + o) = *(int *)(src + o);
unresolved: The exact semantic roles of the many copied float/pair fields (position vs scale vs viewport/clip vs transform parameters) are not established; the getter helpers read them from fixed source offsets but their meaning is context-dependent.
The string field at source+4 and the value at source+136 (which is squared into destination+140) have unknown meaning.

The destination+0 vector is written twice (by F_3VectorCopyToStruct and VectorCopy); the second write is the effective value, which suggests a position followed by an override/direction vector, unproven here.
